# Bug Template

> **Copy this when documenting a bug. Paste at the end of `bug-reports.instructions.md`**

```markdown
---

## BUG-XXX: [Brief Title]

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD  
**Severity:** ?? Critical | ?? High | ?? Medium | ?? Low  
**Component:** [Component Name]

### Problem
[Clear description of what was broken]

### Root Cause
[Technical explanation of why it happened]

**Code Evidence (if relevant):**
```language
// Show problematic code
```

### Solution
[What was changed to fix it]

**Files Modified:**
- `path/to/file.ext` - what changed
- `path/to/another.ext` - what changed

### Prevention
[How to avoid this bug in the future]
- Guideline 1
- Guideline 2
```

---

## Severity Guide

- ?? **Critical** - Feature completely broken, all users affected
- ?? **High** - Major functionality impaired, workaround exists
- ?? **Medium** - Minor issue with easy workaround
- ?? **Low** - Cosmetic or rare edge case

---
